reason: Use Tier 2: decouple SASRec’s context embeddings from its candidate-scoring embeddings. The historical ensemble and 16-negative objective reached 0.6200, while subsequent fusion changes regressed and auxiliary VAE supervision recovered only to 0.5900; this motivates testing a new representation component rather than another fusion adjustment. Shared SASRec embeddings receive both context-encoding and candidate-classification gradients, creating a possible capacity bottleneck that this controlled experiment can test.
